name: POND'S Watermelon Fresh & Bright Translucent Facial Powder For All Skin Types 50gm | International
description:
POND'S Watermelon Fresh & Bright Translucent Facial Powder – 50g

For All Skin Types | Imported from Thailand

Key Features:

Watermelon Extract & Collagen – Softens and adds bounce to the skin

Vitamin E Enriched – Nourishes and protects skin for a healthy glow

Refreshing Summer Powder – Keeps skin cool and revitalized in hot weather

Smooth & Matte Finish – Helps control shine and keeps skin fresh all day

Safe & Brand New – 100% new and unopened product

Benefits:

Softens and refreshes skin with a light watermelon scent

Maintains a smooth, radiant, and bouncy appearance

Suitable for all skin types

Ideal for daily use, especially during warm weather
